'''Aaron Kingery''' is a member of [[Team Albany]]. Matt Sokol's [[DecipherCon 2000]] trip report names him among the Albany players who flew to Kissimmee early and playtested Sokol's Day 3 lists overnight.<ref name="sokol-dt">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-sokols-dcon-2000-reportd1327/ sokols-dcon-2000-report], Matt Sokol, Decktech (11 October 2000)</ref> He played the [[2022 Match Play Championship]] and reached the Top 8 of the [[2014 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-match-play-championship/ 2022 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
